integrity_statement: The theorem is supported by an explicit written argument; numerical checks are supplementary. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only shrinking-mean true Poisson triangular arrays at fixed rare-cell indices, plus fixed positive summable weights and the two named adaptive weights; no bootstrap-size, local-power, or growing-index theorem.
title: Sparse-Poisson staircase limits for empirical-weight goodness-of-fit distances
